Anant Singh Daughter Marriage: anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ke karyakram ke dauran ek dukhad ghatna samne aaee hai. barh anumandal ke nadvan men bhari bhir ke bich ek bujurg arvind kumar achanak behosh ho gae, jinhen aspatal le jane par doktaron ne mrit ghoshit kar diya.
Parijnon ke mutabik, vah shivangi ki shadi men aashirvad dene aur ghurdaur dekhne pahunche the. is ghatna se ilake men shok ka mahaul hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
